registered_plan.registration_status: Written before sensitivity data generation; local record, not third-party timestamp certification.
registered_plan.purpose: Evaluate the frozen method's applicability across observation count and range contamination; inspect sparse-sample CV gating without selecting or retuning a method.
registered_plan.stream_design: For each grid cell use numpy.random.SeedSequence([seed, SCENARIOS.index(scenario), n, round(10000*contamination)]).spawn(cases_per_cell); each child emits one uint64 generate_case seed. Cells and methods share no generated observations, except that all methods receive the same case within a cell.
registered_plan.contamination_realization: The generator corrupts round(n * nominal_rate) observations; save and report actual_outlier_fraction because small n makes realized fractions discrete.
registered_plan.pairing: All three fixed methods evaluate every saved case; mean error differences are computed case by case within each cell.
registered_plan.work_unit_caveat: Modern solvers count residual evaluations including CV and initialization; legacy baselines expose legacy nfev. Counts are implementation-dependent, so retain wall-clock time as well.
registered_plan.inference_scope: Exploratory fixed-grid sensitivity description with only 12 cases per cell. No per-cell significance declarations, universal superiority claims, or multiple-comparison-confirmed conclusions.
registered_plan.prohibition: Validate the original research freeze before generating any case. Do not change the frozen method, choose a winning grid region after inspection as a confirmatory claim, or feed sensitivity outcomes back into the agent. No recalibration or coverage claim is part of this study.
registered_plan.data_scope: Synthetic planar mean-one lognormal distance observations with the original generator's anchor and additive errors; no external radio or industrial dataset.

pre_holdout_integrity_check.claim: Local integrity checks passed; no signed provenance or adversarial tamper guarantee.
